name: aria-context-retrieval
description: Evaluates whether ARIA correctly surfaces and uses the most relevant context.

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: ARIA perfectly recalled and applied all relevant context.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Mostly correct context use; one minor piece of context missed.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Used some context but missed a notable piece.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Largely ignored available context; asked for already-provided information.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Completely failed to use injected or established context.
